idea-plugin.name: Rally Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and manage Rally (Broadcom Agile Central) work items directly from your IDE.


Features:

  • Browse User Stories and Defects with search, scope, state, project, and sprint filters
  • Detail panel with HTML description, linked Test Cases, Tasks, and Attachments
  • View test case steps by double-clicking a test case
  • Create User Stories with project, sprint, and owner assignment
  • Change ticket state (Defined, In-Progress, Completed) with multi-select support
  • Export individual artifacts and linked test cases to JSON/Markdown
  • Sprint summary with ticket counts and story points
  • Open any artifact in Rally web UI, copy FormattedID to clipboard
  • Auto-loads tickets on startup, parallel API queries, 2-minute query cache

Setup:

  1. Open Settings → Tools → Rally
  2. Enter your Rally server URL (e.g., https://rally1.rallydev.com)
  3. Enter your Rally API Key (get it from Rally → Profile → API Keys)
  4. Enter your Workspace Ref and Username
  5. Click "Test Connection" to verify
